entities.summary: Himyarite, a notable figure in the history of Yemen, associated with Himyarite Kingdom and Late Antiquity (110 BCE–525). Their legacy influenced Ethiopian Aksumite invasion and occupation of Yemen and Dhu Nuwas massacres Christians at Najran — triggering Ethiopian invasion.
